I Couldn't figure out how to save my tabs. 

I Glanced at the manual and went through the settings – I could not see a save option. It did not automatically save them either. I am sure there is a way to do it (obviously), but most users will do what I did, remove it and try an alternative. Something to consider.

Unable to import tab-list from ie. Tabs Outliner.
This tab-manager was not updated since anno 2021 either.

Pressing a checkmark placed prime and center to *delete your entire window of tabs* is horribly unintuitive and doesn't ask for any confirmation. I have lost many tabs to this because it looks like it should open the tabs instead.

At first it looked great... Then it sucked big time. Poor UI!! One slightly inaccurate mouse click and you forever lose all your window tabs. No asking for confirmation with a message like, "Are you sure you want to remove ## tabs from you XYZ window?" Nope, it's just gone. What was supposed to help with organization just cost lots of time trying to restore 100 tabs from my browser history.
reviews.dev_reply:
Tabli saves tabs as bookmarks and windows as bookmark folders.
When you un-save an entire window, it doesn't "lose all your windows and tabs", it moves the folder to an _Archive folder in the "Tabli Saved Windows" folder. You can easily restore this saved window with Chrome's Bookmarks Manager just by moving the folder out of that _Archive folder. I would have been happy to explain this and try to help you resolve this issue if I'd gotten a polite message at the widely publicized email address for feedback and bug reports.  Sorry for the poor experience!

reviews.text: Doesn't show the number of tabs open in the icon on the Chrome top bar.

Really helpful, for a user with two 55" monitors and zillions of tabs. Please add the ability to color things into groups as well. And to find the Google Meet or Zoom browser tab. I have a different color for each CHrome profile so it would be helpful to see those same colors within Tabli.

Incredibly useful and well executed add on. I keep wondering why Chrome doesn't just include this functionality, but since they haven't I'm so happy Tabli is here to solve for it. Have pushed this through security reviews at companies because it's so essential to my workflow, this is always the first extension I install on a new machine.
Have been using for a few years now. Appreciate how it is easy to know which windows a tab is part of and can also close out entire windows at once.

So far so good.  Was using another tab manager that just didn't cut and other session/window managers seem inadequate or overpriced.  Would be nice if there were a button/check at the top of the tabs to select/deselect all so I could quickly include new tabs before I close a window.  Thanks for the hard work on this!
tags: save new tabs before closing window

reviews.text: This is a reasonably complex piece of software that does what it says on the tin, with no ads, no nagging for money. What a treat, given the current landscape of software. Thanks dev!

I often have many windows and tabs open, and Tabli helps me stay organized when things get chaotic. I keep Tabli docked to the taskbar for easy access. When a tab is playing audio in the background and I can't find it, the audio icon in Tabli makes it easy to spot. My favorite feature is the search, which lets me type a word and quickly find the tab I need.

I regularly have hundreds of tabs open. Tabli is magical for handling these, especially the search function and the little icon to identify when a tab is playing audio.

Life-changing for sure.
So incredibly useful. I set my working set, my traveling set, and a personal set. Save me time opening the sites I use regularly.

The only extension I’ve found that’s as good as Tabs Outliner—which sadly is no longer being developed. Huge thanks to the developer of this extension—really glad to have a comparable replacement for TO!

Can't even remember when I started using Tabli - definitely before 2017 - but it's an insta-install on any Chromium browser. Was great with The Marvellous Suspender/Great Suspender integration before the Manifest Extension Wipeout of '24, too. Deduplication alone would be enough, but the window saving/management is the cherry on top. Pretty sure I owe another donation by now!

I am not a big user of extensions, but this one is a no brainer. It appears that the current tab design on almost all the web browsers assumed users will only have a handful of them. For the average modern user, the list view provided by Tabli is much more manageable.
tags: browser tab strip fails at many tabs

reviews.text:
I wish I could combine this extension and Simple Tab Sorter (sorts all tabs by domain).

Other than that, the only thing that would make this better is an option to move all tabs from all windows into the current active window (I lose tabs from different chrome profiles on my Mac, which is how I found this extension). And perhaps... voice control? (hold control, "open google")

Great extension. Works well and doesn't nag me for payment. The source code is available and it doesn't steal my data.

The change to use an external pop-up was required by Chrome's extension API and not the developer's preference. Tab Counter is a similar extension that does not open as an external pop-up.
https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/tab-counter/mnkmfefaigfcieehggcbfabgkjijigbc

reviews.text: After trying some more complicated ones, I've settled on this and am happy! It's simple but very beautiful. I had a hard time stomaching the other ones that were so ugly and complicated that they drew my attention away from the task at hand.  This one is great and easy to deal with all the way around. Workona deleted all my tabs and prevented them from showing up in Chrome history, so that was catastrophic. I decided to dial it down and this is sustainable.

I’ve been using Tabli for *years* and it’s always remained stable, efficient, focused (i.e. no addition of bloating unrelated features) and fast. I love the instant search box, I love saved windows (although it’s a clunky experience :) ), I love how it stores its windows in a special bookmarks folder: Other Bookmarks → Tabli Saved Windows.

I tried Toby and Toby Mini and Tabli basically does all that Toby does but much more elegantly and with much greater usability, esp. speed of saving, loading windows.

Cheers !
